days.name: Sun 03/01
days.weather_detail: Sunny (92%), wind 12 mph, 3% precip, gusts 23 mph
days.dinner: Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff over Egg Noodles
days.dinner_description: Tender strips of sirloin seared hard, then braised with cremini and oyster mushrooms, shallots, and a splash of brandy in a silky sour cream sauce spiked with Dijon and paprika. Served over wide egg noodles with a shower of fresh dill and steamed broccoli on the side.
days.dinner_notes: Free Sunday to do an elaborate cook. Uses both cremini and oyster mushrooms.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Good iron from beef; mushrooms add B vitamins and selenium.
days.album_description: Legendary British-Caribbean funk-soul-rock group whose debut is a masterclass in groove. Songs like Bra and The Message are hypnotic, rhythmic, and deeply melodic.
days.album_sonic_description: Laid-back funk with Caribbean percussion, wah-wah guitars, flute melodies, and rich vocal harmonies over deep bass grooves
days.album_pairing_rationale: Warm, groovy Caribbean funk is the perfect Sunday soundtrack for an elaborate stroganoff cook — the kind of music that makes stirring feel like dancing.
days.activity: Free day — grocery run, prep for the week
days.activity_notes: Nice enough to get outside (50°F). Prep broccoli for the week — cut 5+ lbs of florets and stems.
prep_notes: Cut and bag broccoli florets and stems for the week

days.name: Mon 03/02
days.weather_detail: Cloudy (21%), wind 8 mph, 30% precip, gusts 21 mph
days.dinner_description: Thick-cut baked ham layered with thinly sliced Yukon Gold potatoes and blanched broccoli florets, blanketed in a sharp cheddar béchamel. Baked until bubbling and golden on top.
days.dinner_notes: Perfect snowy Monday comfort food. One-dish meal, oven does the work.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Ham provides protein and B vitamins; potatoes add potassium; broccoli adds vitamins C and K.
days.album_description: Melbourne’s Surprise Chef deliver cinematic instrumental funk-soul that sounds like a lost 1970s soundtrack. Each track pulses with rhythm and storytelling through melody alone.
days.album_sonic_description: Vintage analog funk-soul with Rhodes piano, warm bass, tight drums, horns, and strings evoking 1970s blaxploitation soundtracks
days.album_pairing_rationale: A cinematic instrumental soundtrack for a cozy snow-day gratin — warm, unhurried, and perfect for watching the snow fall while the oven does its work.
prep_notes: Assemble gratin in the morning or after work

days.name: Tue 03/03
days.weather_detail: Cloudy (0%), wind 9 mph, 75% precip, gusts 28 mph
time_constraints: Swim lessons at 6pm — dinner needs to be quick after or prepped before
days.dinner: Babo Pasta — Homemade Spinach Pasta with Alfredo Sauce
days.dinner_description: Handmade spinach pasta using only egg yolks for a rich, golden dough, tossed in a simple Alfredo of butter, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and pasta water. Family signature dish. Serve with steamed broccoli on the side.
days.dinner_notes: Family signature dish. Make the pasta dough before swim, cook after.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Eggs provide protein and choline; spinach adds iron and folate; broccoli for vitamin C.
days.album_description: London’s Kokoroko blend West African highlife and Afrobeat with jazz and neo-soul into something entirely fresh — warm, rhythmic, and deeply human.
days.album_sonic_description: Afrobeat-jazz fusion with highlife guitar, trumpet melodies, soft percussion, and gentle vocals over deep pocket grooves
days.album_pairing_rationale: Warm, hopeful Afrobeat-jazz for a post-swim wind-down with homemade pasta — the grooves are gentle enough for a tired Tuesday but rhythmic enough to keep the kitchen moving.
days.activity_notes: Snowy day, 40°F — bundle up for the drive.
prep_notes: Make pasta dough before swim lessons
Steam broccoli while boiling pasta water

days.name: Wed 03/04
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (75%), wind 12 mph, 42% precip, gusts 38 mph
time_constraints: Busy work day — quick dinner needed
days.dinner: Beef & Broccoli Stir Fry with Oyster Mushrooms
days.dinner_description: Velveted flank steak wok-seared with broccoli florets and oyster mushrooms in a glossy sauce of oyster sauce, soy, garlic, ginger, and Shaoxing wine. Green onions piled on top.
days.dinner_notes: Quick wok meal after a long Product Day. 30 minutes start to finish.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Beef provides iron and B12; broccoli adds vitamin C to aid iron absorption; mushrooms for selenium.
days.album: The Budos Band – Long in the Tooth
days.album_description: Staten Island’s Budos Band merge Afrobeat, heavy funk, and psychedelic rock into thunderous instrumental grooves. Raw energy from start to finish.
days.album_sonic_description: Heavy Afrobeat-funk with distorted guitars, blaring horns, pounding drums, and a wall of rhythm that hits like a freight train
days.album_pairing_rationale: The driving energy of Afrobeat-funk matches the fast pace of wok cooking — high heat, quick moves, thunderous results. Perfect after a long Product Day.
days.activity_notes: 62°F and warming up — spring is arriving!
prep_notes: Slice steak and prep vegetables before work

days.name: Thu 03/05
days.weather_detail: Sunny (92%), wind 13 mph, 28% precip, gusts 37 mph
days.dinner: Broccoli & Oyster Mushroom Flatbread with Ricotta & Chili Honey
days.dinner_description: Store-bought or homemade pizza dough stretched thin and topped with dollops of ricotta, roasted broccoli florets, sautéed oyster mushrooms, red pepper flakes, and a drizzle of hot honey after baking. Crispy, creamy, sweet-spicy.
days.dinner_notes: Light, casual, fun for a warm spring evening. Get Elsie involved in topping the flatbread.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Ricotta provides calcium and protein; broccoli for vitamins; mushrooms add umami and B vitamins.
days.album_description: UK collective Nubiyan Twist fuse Afrobeat, jazz, dub, funk, and soul with rotating vocalists into a joyful, genre-defying album that’s pure energy.
days.album_sonic_description: Genre-blending ensemble with Afrobeat rhythms, jazz horns, dub bass, funk guitar, and soulful vocals from multiple guest singers
days.album_pairing_rationale: Joyful, celebratory energy for the first real spring evening (73°F!) — a soundtrack for making flatbread with the windows open and spring air flowing in.
days.activity: First warm spring evening — enjoy the 73°F!
days.activity_notes: Open the windows, maybe eat on the patio.
prep_notes: Roast broccoli and sauté mushrooms while dough comes to room temp

days.name: Fri 03/06
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (85%), wind 10 mph, 28% precip, gusts 17 mph
time_constraints: Elsie at YAT until 6pm — start cooking while she’s out
days.dinner: Pan-Seared Branzino with Lemon-Herb Butter & Roasted Broccoli
days.dinner_description: Skin-on branzino fillets seared until the skin crackles, finished with a pan sauce of brown butter, lemon, capers, and fresh herbs. Served alongside broccoli roasted at 425°F until charred at the tips.
days.dinner_notes: Dad’s fish craving. Simple, elegant, 25 minutes.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Branzino is lean protein rich in omega-3s; broccoli adds fiber and vitamins C and K.
days.elsie_note: Elsie’s not a fan of fish this week — have buttered pasta or a quesadilla ready as her backup, plus the roasted broccoli she loves.
days.album_description: Brazilian legend Marcos Valle’s grooviest album — a sun-drenched blend of bossa nova, funk, and psychedelic soul that practically smells like the ocean.
days.album_sonic_description: Brazilian funk-soul with bossa nova rhythms, lush orchestration, Fender Rhodes, and Valle’s smooth vocals floating over syncopated grooves
days.album_pairing_rationale: Breezy Brazilian grooves for a Mediterranean fish dinner — the ocean vibes of Garra complement branzino perfectly, and the rhythm keeps Friday evening energy flowing.
prep_notes: Start roasting broccoli while Elsie is at YAT

days.name: Sat 03/07
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (64%), wind 13 mph, 27% precip, gusts 33 mph
days.dinner: BBQ Pork Butt with Broccoli Slaw
days.dinner_description: Pork butt rubbed with smoked paprika, brown sugar, mustard powder, and black pepper, slow-cooked low and slow until falling apart. Piled on brioche buns with a tangy broccoli slaw made from shredded broccoli stems, cabbage, apple cider vinegar, and a touch of mayo.
days.dinner_notes: 73°F grilling weather! Start the pork butt in the morning for evening BBQ. Zero-waste broccoli slaw uses stems.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Pork provides protein, thiamine, and zinc; cabbage slaw adds vitamin C and fiber.
days.album_description: Curtis Mayfield’s legendary soundtrack — funky, socially conscious, and impossibly groovy. One of the greatest soul albums ever made.
days.album_sonic_description: Wah-wah guitars, orchestral strings, tight funk rhythms, and Mayfield’s soaring falsetto delivering sharp social commentary over irresistible grooves
days.album_pairing_rationale: The ultimate BBQ soundtrack — Curtis Mayfield’s funky, groovy soul is exactly what a warm Saturday pork butt cook demands. Turn it up, tend the fire, let the music do its work.
days.activity_notes: 73°F — perfect outdoor cooking weather. Maybe eat outside.

appetizers.name: Charred Broccoli with Whipped Feta, Lemon & Chili Oil
appetizers.description: Broccoli florets roasted at 450°F until deeply charred and crispy at the edges, served over a swipe of whipped feta blended with lemon zest and a drizzle of homemade chili oil. Scattered with toasted sesame seeds and flaky salt.

appetizers.name: Stuffed Cremini Mushrooms with Parmesan, Herbs & Green Onions
appetizers.description: Large cremini mushroom caps filled with a mixture of their own diced stems, Parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, green onions, and fresh parsley, then baked until golden and bubbling.

salads.name: Roasted Broccoli, Blood Orange & Burrata Salad
salads.description: A composed arrangement of warm roasted broccoli florets, blood orange segments, torn burrata, toasted hazelnuts, and shaved Pecorino.
salads.dressing: Blood orange vinaigrette: fresh blood orange juice, white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, extra-virgin olive oil, minced shallot, honey, flaky salt, cracked black pepper
salads.flavor_rationale: The char on roasted broccoli provides nutty bitterness that blood orange tames with tart sweetness. Burrata adds lush creaminess. Italian amaro-dolce principles at work.

salads.name: Chopped Broccoli, Kale & Apple Salad with Cheddar Croutons
salads.description: Finely chopped raw broccoli, massaged lacinato kale, crisp Honeycrisp apple matchsticks, toasted sunflower seeds, dried cranberries, and sharp cheddar croutons.
salads.dressing: Apple cider vinaigrette: apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, maple syrup, extra-virgin olive oil, minced shallot, salt, black pepper
salads.flavor_rationale: Raw broccoli crunch pairs with tender massaged kale. Apple sweetness and cranberry tartness play against sharp cheddar croutons. Maple-mustard vinaigrette unifies with autumnal warmth.

salads.name: Asian Broccoli Slaw with Sesame-Ginger Dressing
salads.description: Shredded broccoli stems and florets, shaved carrots, red cabbage, and edamame tossed in a bright sesame-ginger dressing. Topped with crispy wonton strips.
salads.dressing: Sesame-ginger dressing: toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, fresh grated ginger, soy sauce, honey, neutral oil, lime juice, garlic, salt
salads.flavor_rationale: Nutty sesame oil grounds bright rice vinegar and lime acid. Fresh ginger adds heat. Transforms raw cruciferous crunch into something addictive.

salads.name: Shaved Fennel, Radicchio & Citrus Salad with Marcona Almonds
salads.description: Paper-thin fennel, torn radicchio, navel orange supremes, and a scattering of Marcona almonds. A palate cleanser that cuts through rich mains.
salads.dressing: Lemon-shallot vinaigrette: fresh lemon juice, finely minced shallot, champagne vinegar, extra-virgin olive oil, Dijon mustard, flaky salt, cracked black pepper
salads.flavor_rationale: Fennel anise sweetness tames radicchio bitterness. Citrus adds juicy brightness. Marcona almonds bring buttery richness and crunch. Classic bitter-sweet-acid Mediterranean triad.

beverages.name: Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
beverages.description: Bright, medium-bodied Pinot Noir with cherry, cranberry, and forest floor notes. Enough acidity to cut through creamy stroganoff, enough fruit to complement grilled pork.
beverages.why: Versatile red that works across the week’s diverse proteins.

beverages.name: Weihenstephaner Hefeweizen
beverages.description: The world’s oldest brewery’s flagship wheat beer — hazy gold with banana, clove, and bread crust aromas. Effervescent and refreshing.
beverages.why: Classic pairing for BBQ and grilled meats. The 73°F grilling weather demands a cold Hefe.

beverages.name: Cucumber-Mint Agua Fresca with Lime
beverages.description: English cucumber, fresh mint, lime juice, and a touch of agave blended with cold water and strained. Light, herbal, and impossibly refreshing.
beverages.why: Non-alcoholic option the whole family can enjoy. Elsie’s drink of the week.

Beverages: Cucumbers and mint for agua fresca

prep_ahead: Saturday night: Dry-rub pork butt for Saturday BBQ
Sunday: Cut and bag 5+ lbs broccoli florets and stems for the week
Sunday: Make pasta dough for Tuesday (can rest overnight in fridge)
Monday: Slice flank steak for Wednesday stir fry
Tuesday: Make pasta dough before swim if not done Sunday
Thursday: Prep broccoli slaw for Saturday (shred stems and cabbage)
notes: Broccoli features in every single dinner this week — goal is to use 15+ lbs
Oyster mushrooms appear in 3 dishes (stroganoff, stir fry, flatbread)
Cremini mushrooms in stroganoff and appetizer
Green onions in stir fry, mushroom appetizer, and multiple dishes
Stroganoff and gratin both make excellent lunch leftovers for meal prep
Saturday BBQ pork butt will have enough for leftovers through next week
